description.en: Browse specifications and use cases across the MEDIKEEP, CAREKEEP, and INDUKEEP wiping lines.

title.zh:
三条产品线。
一套洁净系统。

body.zh: 规格可以变化，但产品逻辑保持一致：明确场景、稳定擦拭、可靠包装、批次可追溯。
body.en: Formats can change, but the logic stays constant: clear use case, stable wiping, reliable packaging, and batch traceability.

skus.title: Alcohol Disinfectant Wipes
skus.alt: Alcohol Disinfectant Wipes 产品场景

body.zh: 适用于高频接触表面、设备外壳和快速挥发清洁需求。
body.en: Built for high-touch surfaces, equipment shells, and fast-evaporation cleaning.

intro.zh: 70% 酒精快速挥发体系，适合医疗空间中高频接触点的日常清洁与消毒前处理。
intro.en: A 70% alcohol fast-dry format for daily cleaning and disinfection preparation on high-touch points in clinical spaces.

gallery.alt: Alcohol Disinfectant Wipes 桶装包装
医疗空间接触面擦拭场景
洁净擦拭产品包装细节

highlights.zh: 快速挥发，减少表面残留与等待时间。
highlights.en: Fast evaporation reduces surface residue and waiting time.

highlights.zh: 低掉屑基材，适合设备外壳、推车、床旁高频表面。
highlights.en: Low-lint substrate suits equipment shells, carts, and bedside high-touch surfaces.

highlights.zh: 桶装抽取结构，支持连续作业与现场补给。
highlights.en: Canister dispensing supports continuous work and point-of-use replenishment.

value.zh: 硬质、非多孔高频接触表面
充分润湿表面，并按当地法规与验证要求执行接触时间。
value.en: Fully wet the surface and follow contact time required by local regulation and validation.

usage.zh: 打开桶盖并从中心抽取单片湿巾。
usage.en: Open the canister and pull one wipe from the center feed.

usage.zh: 按一个方向擦拭目标表面，确保表面被均匀润湿。
usage.en: Wipe the target surface in one direction and ensure even wetting.

usage.zh: 使用后及时合盖，避免液体挥发；废弃物按现场规范处理。
usage.en: Close the lid after use to reduce evaporation; dispose of waste according to site procedures.

skus.title: Clinical Disinfectant Wipes
skus.alt: Clinical Disinfectant Wipes 产品场景

body.zh: 为诊疗空间、公共区域和非侵入式设备表面提供稳定消毒擦拭。
body.en: Designed for treatment zones, public areas, and non-invasive equipment surfaces with stable disinfecting performance.

intro.zh: 低残留临床消毒擦拭方案，适用于医院、诊所与公共卫生空间的日常表面管理。
intro.en: A low-residue clinical disinfecting wipe for daily surface management in hospitals, clinics, and public health spaces.

gallery.alt: Clinical Disinfectant Wipes 软包产品
洁净医疗环境与感染控制现场
临床表面擦拭作业

highlights.zh: 湿润保持稳定，适合连续擦拭诊疗区域。
highlights.en: Stable wetting supports continuous wiping across treatment zones.

highlights.zh: 翻盖软包便于床旁、护士站和公共区域快速取用。
highlights.en: Flip-top soft pack enables fast access beside beds, nursing stations, and public areas.

highlights.zh: 配方与基材兼顾清洁效率和表面兼容性。
highlights.en: Formula and substrate balance cleaning efficiency with surface compatibility.

value.zh: 诊疗空间、公共区域、非侵入式设备外表面
value.en: Treatment zones, public areas, and non-invasive equipment exteriors

value.zh: 根据目标市场法规、微生物谱和接触时间进行第三方验证。
value.en: Validate against target-market regulation, organism spectrum, and contact time.

usage.zh: 打开翻盖后取出湿巾，避免手部接触未使用湿巾。
usage.en: Open the flip lid and remove one wipe without touching unused wipes.

usage.zh: 由洁净区域向污染区域擦拭，单片湿巾不跨区域复用。
usage.en: Wipe from clean to contaminated areas and do not reuse one wipe across zones.

usage.zh: 使用后压紧翻盖，保持包装密封。
usage.en: Press the flip lid closed after use to preserve pack seal integrity.

skus.title: Chlorhexidine Wash Cloths
skus.alt: Chlorhexidine Wash Cloths 产品场景

body.zh: 面向临床辅助清洁和术前准备流程的柔软大尺寸擦拭布。
body.en: Soft large-format cloths for clinical support cleaning and pre-op preparation routines.

intro.zh: 柔软大尺寸 CHG 洗护布，支持临床辅助清洁、术前准备与护理流程中的稳定覆盖。
intro.en: A soft large-format CHG wash cloth for clinical support cleansing, pre-op preparation, and controlled coverage during care routines.

gallery.alt: Chlorhexidine Wash Cloths 单片包装
感染控制护理现场
临床产品文件和安全资料

highlights.zh: 加厚柔感布面，减少护理过程中的拉扯感。
highlights.en: Thicker soft-touch cloth helps reduce pulling during care.

highlights.zh: 单片包装便于流程分配与批次管理。
highlights.en: Single pouches support procedure allocation and batch control.

highlights.zh: 大尺寸设计提升覆盖面积，减少反复取片。
highlights.en: Large size improves coverage and reduces repeated wipe retrieval.

value.zh: 临床辅助清洁、术前准备、护理流程
value.en: Clinical support cleansing, pre-op preparation, and care routines

value.zh: 按医疗机构流程与当地法规使用，不用于开放性伤口。
value.en: Use according to facility protocol and local regulation; not intended for open wounds.

usage.zh: 使用前确认包装完整和批次信息。
usage.en: Check pack integrity and batch information before use.

usage.zh: 打开单片包装后立即使用，按护理流程擦拭目标区域。
usage.en: Open the single pouch and use immediately according to the care protocol.

usage.zh: 避免重复污染；使用后按医疗废弃物规范处理。
usage.en: Avoid recontamination; dispose of used cloth according to medical waste rules.

skus.title: Rinse-free Bath Wipes
skus.alt: Rinse-free Bath Wipes 产品场景

body.zh: 为卧床护理、旅行和日常身体清洁提供免冲洗护理体验。
body.en: A no-rinse body-care format for bedside care, travel, and everyday cleansing.

intro.zh: 免冲洗身体清洁湿巾，适合卧床护理、差旅和不便沐浴场景。
intro.en: No-rinse body cleansing wipes for bedside care, travel, and moments when bathing is inconvenient.

gallery.alt: Rinse-free Bath Wipes 翻盖包装
温和个人护理场景
家庭护理和清洁用品

highlights.zh: 免冲洗配方，减少护理流程对水源的依赖。
highlights.en: No-rinse lotion reduces reliance on water during care routines.

highlights.zh: 亲肤柔感基材，适合大面积身体清洁。
highlights.en: Soft skin-friendly substrate suits larger-area body cleansing.

highlights.zh: 翻盖软包控制开封后的湿润度。
highlights.en: Flip-top pack helps retain moisture after opening.

usage.zh: 打开翻盖，取出一片湿巾。
usage.en: Open the flip lid and remove one wipe.

usage.zh: 按身体区域分区擦拭，必要时更换新片。
usage.en: Clean by body zone and switch to a new wipe when needed.

usage.zh: 使用后无需冲洗；如皮肤不适请停止使用。
usage.en: No rinsing is required; stop use if skin irritation occurs.

skus.title: Rinse-free Bath Gloves
skus.alt: Rinse-free Bath Gloves 产品场景

body.zh: 手套型结构提升抓握和覆盖面积，适合护理人员高效操作。
body.en: A glove format improves grip and coverage for faster caregiver handling.

intro.zh: 免冲洗手套型清洁产品，让护理人员在移动、翻身和身体清洁时更容易控制接触面。
intro.en: A no-rinse glove format that gives caregivers better contact control during repositioning and body cleansing.

gallery.alt: Rinse-free Bath Gloves 包装与手套结构
个人护理产品应用场景
护理用品和文档资料

highlights.zh: 手套结构提升抓握稳定性，减少滑脱。
highlights.en: Glove shape improves grip stability and reduces slipping.

highlights.zh: 双层柔感基材，兼顾覆盖和舒适触感。
highlights.en: Dual-layer soft substrate balances coverage and comfort.

highlights.zh: 适合护理机构、家庭护理和旅行护理包。
highlights.en: Fits care facilities, home care, and travel care kits.

usage.zh: 取出手套并套入手部，确认湿润面覆盖掌心。
usage.en: Remove the glove and wear it with the wet surface covering the palm.

usage.zh: 按护理流程擦拭身体区域，避免重复污染。
usage.en: Clean body areas according to care procedure and avoid recontamination.

usage.zh: 使用后丢弃，不可重复使用。
usage.en: Dispose after use; do not reuse.

skus.title: Continence Care Wipes
skus.alt: Continence Care Wipes 产品场景

body.zh: 针对成人失禁护理，兼顾清洁、舒缓和皮肤屏障保护。
body.en: For continence care routines that need cleansing, soothing, and skin barrier support together.

intro.zh: 失禁护理湿巾将清洁、舒缓与屏障护理整合到同一流程，适合长期护理与家庭护理。
intro.en: A continence-care wipe that combines cleansing, soothing, and barrier support for long-term care and home care.

gallery.alt: Continence Care Wipes 软包包装
亲肤护理应用场景
护理资源与操作说明

highlights.zh: 大尺寸加厚布面，适合成人护理高频更换场景。
highlights.en: Large thick cloth suits frequent adult-care changes.

highlights.zh: 舒缓护理配方，兼顾清洁和皮肤屏障支持。
highlights.en: Soothing care formula supports cleansing and skin-barrier comfort.

highlights.zh: 软包翻盖易取用，便于床旁和护理车配置。
highlights.en: Flip-top soft pack is easy to place bedside or on care carts.

usage.zh: 从翻盖取出湿巾，按护理区域单向擦拭。
usage.en: Remove a wipe from the flip lid and wipe one-way across the care area.

usage.zh: 根据污染程度更换新片，避免重复污染。
usage.en: Use a new wipe according to soil level to avoid recontamination.

usage.zh: 外用产品，请勿冲入马桶。
usage.en: For external use only; do not flush.

skus.title: Heavy Duty Oil Removal Wipes
skus.alt: Heavy Duty Oil Removal Wipes 产品场景

body.zh: 面向机械维修、设备保养、喷涂前处理和油污重清洁的高强度工业擦拭产品。
body.en: A heavy-duty wipe for machinery repair, maintenance, pre-coating prep, and severe oil removal.

intro.zh: 高吸油、耐撕裂、耐溶剂的工业擦拭布，面向高强度维护、喷涂前处理和油污重清洁。
intro.en: A high-absorbency, tear-resistant, solvent-resistant industrial wipe for heavy maintenance, pre-coating prep, and severe oil removal.

gallery.alt: Heavy Duty Oil Removal Wipes 工业维修场景
工业设备维护与洁净作业
制造现场擦拭和维护

highlights.zh: 高吸油能力，适合油污、润滑脂和设备维护残留。
highlights.en: High oil absorbency for oil, grease, and maintenance residue.

highlights.zh: 增强复合结构，湿态擦拭不易破裂。
highlights.en: Reinforced composite structure resists tearing during wet wiping.

highlights.zh: 大包装适合车间、产线和维修站点集中补给。
highlights.en: Bulk pack supports centralized supply for workshops, lines, and service bays.

usage.zh: 按作业区域取用擦拭布，避免将重油污带入洁净工序。
usage.en: Take wipes by work zone to avoid carrying heavy soil into cleaner processes.

usage.zh: 先去除大面积油污，再对关键接触面进行二次精擦。
usage.en: Remove bulk oil first, then perform a second fine wipe on critical contact surfaces.

usage.zh: 含油废弃物按工厂 EHS 规范分类处理。
usage.en: Dispose of oil-contaminated waste according to plant EHS procedures.

value.zh: 木浆复合增强低尘工业布
high oil absorbency / solvent resistant / tear resistant
value.en: high oil absorbency / solvent resistant / tear resistant
